basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Lund University (Lund, Helsingborg, and Malmö Campuses, Sweden)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all international Bachelor's and Master's degree programmes across all faculties: Faculty of Engineering (LTH - Wireless Communications, Machine Learning, Systems & Control, Biotechnology, Nanotechnology, Energy), Faculty of Science (Astrophysics, Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology, Physics), Faculty of Medicine (Public Health), School of Economics & Management, Faculty of Law, and Faculty of Social Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 45 competitive tuition awards (ranging from 25%, 50%, 75% to 100% tuition coverage) awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; Pakistani students with first-class engineering and computing degrees are well-represented (typically 3 to 7 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of the degree program: 1 year, 2 years (Master's), or 3 years (Bachelor's), contingent upon passing 100% of required credits

nationality_requirements: Citizens of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland required to pay tuition fees
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed high school with 90%+ for Bachelor's; completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum 3.75 / 4.00 CGPA or 82%+ aggregate from recognized Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST, LUMS, QAU, UET, GIKI, PIEAS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalence to Swedish Pass with Distinction (VG); top 10% class ranking required.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate background directly satisfying the specific entry prerequisites of the chosen Lund program.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before autumn intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Academic excellence is the primary basis; technical projects, research, and leadership strengthen the motivation essay.

english_proficiency.notes: English 6 requirement: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (subscores 5.5+) or TOEFL iBT min 90 (writing 20+).

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite international scholars in Engineering, Computing, Nanotechnology, and Biomedical Sciences.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with Swedish Institute (SI) full scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: LUGS awards cover 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of the international tuition fee (top candidates receive 100% full waiver of SEK 120,000 to SEK 260,000/year; ~PKR 3,350,000 to 7,250,000/yr).

admission_application_fee.details: Swedish central application fee (SEK 900) paid by applicant to Universityadmissions.se.

accommodation.details: Housing is self-funded; LU Accommodation (LU Acc) provides housing guarantees for fee-paying and scholarship students.
accommodation.amount: Student room rent ~SEK 4,200 to 6,000 / month (~PKR 115,000 to 165,000 / mo)

monthly_stipend.details: LUGS is strictly a tuition fee scholarship; students must show proof of ~SEK 10,314/month living funds for the Swedish residence permit.

airfare.details: Travel expenses to Sweden are borne by the candidate.

visa_fee.details: Swedish residence permit application fee (SEK 1,500) paid to Swedish Migration Agency.

health_insurance.details: Lund University covers all international fee-paying and scholarship students with the Swedish FAS+ comprehensive health and accident insurance free of charge.

food_allowance.details: Living expenses covered by student (~SEK 2,500 to 3,500/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Course textbooks and materials paid by student.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to MAX IV Synchrotron Laboratory, European Spallation Source (ESS), and top-tier LTH engineering research groups.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Skånetrafiken student monthly pass (~SEK 650/month) paid by student.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (Lund University, Sweden - QS World Rank #73, Global Top 100)
participating_institutions: Lund University (Faculty of Engineering - LTH, Faculty of Science, School of Economics and Management)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Scandinavia's highest-ranked comprehensive university; world leader in Nanotechnology, Wireless Communications (birthplace of Bluetooth), and Medicine.
available_majors: Disaster Risk Management and Climate Change Adaptation
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 3 years (180 ECTS); Master's: 1 or 2 years (60 or 120 ECTS).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with minimum 3.75+ CGPA, detailed course match, program ranked as #1 preference on Universityadmissions.se, and approved English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: LTH engineering programs (Wireless Communication, Machine Learning) are intensely competitive globally; Science and Public Health have strong scholarship allocations for candidates with research output.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Critical requirement: You MUST rank the Lund University program as your FIRST CHOICE (Priority 1) on Universityadmissions.se before the 15 January deadline. In February, write a focused 650-word LUGS motivation letter directly answering Lund's prompt.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University Admissions in Sweden & Lund University Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit program application on universityadmissions.se by 15 January ranking Lund as Priority 1, pay application fee, then apply for LUGS via Lund's scholarship portal in February.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Create an account on universityadmissions.se and search for Lund University programs.
Step 2: Add your target Lund program and rank it as your FIRST CHOICE (Priority 1).
Step 3: Pay the SEK 900 application fee before the national deadline (1 February).
Step 4: Upload all academic transcripts, degree certificate, syllabus, and English score to universityadmissions.se.
Step 5: In early February, access the Lund University Global Scholarship application portal.
Step 6: Enter your 8-digit application number and submit the LUGS motivation essay (max 650 words).
Step 7: Submit the scholarship application before the strict February deadline.
Step 8: Swedish national admissions results announced in late March.
Step 9: Lund University releases scholarship decisions in early April to admitted candidates.
Step 10: Formally accept the scholarship within 10 days, receive Confirmation, and apply for Swedish residence permit.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual application: Program application on universityadmissions.se, followed by online scholarship application on Lund University portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Not required for general scholarship application; reviewed through national admissions upload if program requires it.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: LUGS Motivation Essay (max 650 words): Explain why you chose Lund University, how your academic performance qualifies you, and your potential to excel and make an impact.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for taught MSc; research interests stated in motivation essay.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV outlining courses, technical projects, thesis abstract, and academic honours.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews conducted; purely document-based evaluation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+, subscores 5.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Color scanned copies of original degrees and transcripts; verified documents must meet Swedish Universityadmissions.se country-specific rules for Pakistan (degrees verified by HEC).
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online via Universityadmissions.se and Lund University scholarship portal.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 15 January (National application deadline on Universityadmissions.se); Mid-February (Lund scholarship portal deadline)
important_dates_timeline.document_submission_deadline: 1 February (Fee payment and document upload deadline)
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: Late March (Admissions results) & Early April (Scholarship results)
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: April - June (Swedish residence permit application via Migrationsverket)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: One annual national intake cycle. You must apply by 15 January and rank Lund as #1 choice to be eligible for scholarship.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Undergraduate GPA, academic grades in relevant subjects, and university reputation)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Undergraduate research projects, publications, and thesis grade)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of LUGS scholarship motivation essay and academic ambition)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Lund University Scholarship Committee comprising faculty deans, admissions directors, and academic staff.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Selection is purely merit-based. Applicants are evaluated based on their academic transcripts and motivation essay. Scholarships are awarded to candidates with the highest academic excellence who have ranked Lund as their first choice.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~4,000 to 6,000 non-EU applicants apply to Lund University Master's programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~30 to 45 tuition scholarships awarded annually across all levels
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1% to 2% (Achievable for top 5% graduates from NUST, FAST, LUMS, QAU, GIKI with 3.8+ GPA)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of premier universities with high thesis grades, excellent mathematical and technical backgrounds, and strong motivation.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Wireless Communication, Machine Learning, Biotechnology, Nanotechnology, and Physics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, China, USA, Indonesia, Turkey, Bangladesh.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial consultancies claiming they can secure Swedish scholarships for fees. All applications must be submitted via universityadmissions.se.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Universityadmissions.se charges a national SEK 900 application fee. Lund University charges NO separate scholarship fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never allow agents to fill out your universityadmissions.se account; personal access and accurate documentation are essential.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Living expenses are NOT covered by the scholarship; students must show proof of ~SEK 10,314/month living funds for the Swedish residence permit.
Flight tickets between Pakistan and Copenhagen Kastrup (closest airport to Lund, ~PKR 180,000 - 250,000).
Winter clothing and initial settlement expenses (~SEK 5,000 - 8,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: The scholarship includes monthly living stipend. (FACT: LUGS is strictly a tuition fee waiver).
CLAIM: You can win the scholarship if Lund is your second choice. (FACT: You MUST rank Lund as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some aggregator websites confuse LUGS with the Swedish Institute (SI) scholarship which covers living costs.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Scholars must maintain satisfactory academic progress and complete at least 75% of credits (45 out of 60 ECTS) in Year 1 to qualify for Year 2 tuition waiver.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance on campus in Lund.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual credit completion check conducted by the International Office.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Sweden allows international students to work with no legal limit on hours, provided academic studies remain full-time.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates can apply for a 12-month post-study residence permit to seek employment in Sweden.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Tuition waiver is terminated if study progress is unsatisfactory or if student drops out; no clawback of past waived tuition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the scholarship committee and faculty admissions board.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the nominal duration of the program.
